digest.component_or_area: shared git seam (gitutil) and event store write path
propositions: Write-side transient runner-FS faults (ENOENT/EINVAL temp-file creation) are retried in event_append._git_add but not in the shared gitutil.run_git_write seam, causing identical faults to self-heal on one path and abort CI on another
gitutil._with_transient_head_retry only classifies READ-side markers (could not parse head, bad object) and does not match write-side loose-object temp-create signatures
event_append defines a private _TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS family with write-side markers that is not shared with other run_git_write callers (s3_doctor, compaction, claim/transition writers)

Moving the write-side marker classification into gitutil as a unified _is_transient_git_fault predicate ensures all run_git_write callers inherit the same bounded 3-attempt retry budget for write-side faults
Corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate data stream error) must remain excluded from retry to fail fast on genuine data corruption
